info.title: EnergiTrack API
info.description: OpenAPI route inventory generated from Express declarations. Request schemas are endpoint-specific where documented. Pagination and meter reading cursor response envelopes are typed; most domain response payloads remain JSONValue until their endpoint-specific contracts are added. See docs/api.md for current business rules.
